name: chord-agent
description: Chord agent harness: a stdio bridge to the hosted Chord MCP and a function-calling manifest. Market data and unsigned swap transactions on Ethereum, Monad, Robinhood Chain, Arc, Avalanche, Base, BNB Chain, Arbitrum One and Solana; the chain is a parameter of every tool.

scripts.manifest: node dist/manifest.js > tools.json && mkdir -p ../web/public/agent && cp tools.json ../web/public/agent/tools.json
